name: nordrelay
description: Start, stop, restart, troubleshoot, and inspect NordRelay, a secure remote control plane for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Start, stop, restart, troubleshoot, and inspect the local NordRelay runtime from Codex. NordRelay connects Codex, Pi, Hermes, OpenClaw, and Claude Code to its WebUI, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix, and trusted peer nodes. Full session control remains in those NordRelay surfaces; this Codex plugin manages the local process.
defaultPrompt: Start NordRelay and verify its status.
Show NordRelay status and recent errors.
Troubleshoot why NordRelay is not running.
